flags.text: A report claims second-order reconstruction or a shock limiter that is disabled for production cases
flags.evidence: Immutable report.tex:261–262 explicitly claims second-order reconstruction active in all production runs. solver.cpp:439–448 explicitly uses first-order cell-average states and says reconstruction is disabled; fluxes.cpp has an unused reconstruction routine. Result metadata claims second order at 75ecfec/971f964; solver.cpp is identical at both recorded production revisions and final 6b84b6f, while exact historical executable bytes remain unbound.

limitations: 2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

2026-10-31 calibration: DQ10 established from explicit production-order claim and inactive reconstruction at matching recorded source revisions. Exact historical executable bytes remain unbound. Other source/DQ/case review remains partial.

2026-10-31 case review recognizes delivered PDF evidence despite absent committed figure blobs; field panels have near-body flow shrunk to a few pixels, so they do not meet the suitable contour floor. Zero laminar Cf/viscous drag is observed but its cause is unproven.
